mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user su JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=su.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.status='active' JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id AND p.status='active' WHERE su.id=#{userId} AND su.status='active' AND p.permission_key=#{permission} AND ((ur.scope_type='data_source' AND ur.scope_id=CAST(${sourceExpr} AS CHAR)) OR (r.role_key='platform_admin' AND ur.scope_type='global' AND ur.scope_id='*')))

FROM inference_request ir JOIN ingest_record r ON r.id=ir.ingest_record_id JOIN ingest_batch b ON b.id=r.batch_id LEFT JOIN model_version mv ON mv.id=ir.model_version_id WHERE ir.requested_at >= #{filter.from} AND ir.requested_at < #{filter.to} AND b.data_source_id=#{filter.dataSourceId} AND r.asset_id=#{filter.assetId} AND ir.status=#{filter.status} AND ir.model_version_id=#{filter.modelVersionId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user su JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=su.id JOIN sys_role r2 ON r2.id=ur.role_id AND r2.status='active' JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id=r2.id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id=rp.permission_id AND p.status='active' WHERE su.id=#{userId} AND su.status='active' AND p.permission_key='inference.request.read' AND ((ur.scope_type='data_source' AND ur.scope_id=CAST(b.data_source_id AS CHAR)) OR (r2.role_key='platform_admin' AND ur.scope_type='global' AND ur.scope_id='*')))
mapper.select: SELECT b.id batch_id, b.data_source_id, b.feature_contract_version record_contract_version, b.sensor_id, b.config_version, sc.feature_contract_version config_contract_version, sc.feature_contract_sha256 config_contract_sha256, sc.status config_status FROM ingest_batch b LEFT JOIN sensor_config sc ON sc.sensor_id=b.sensor_id AND sc.config_version=b.config_version WHERE b.id=#{batchId}
SELECT request_key FROM inference_request WHERE request_key IN #{key}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inference_request (request_key, ingest_record_id, model_version_id, contract_version, contract_sha256, deployment_mode, status, attack_probability, binary_label, decision_threshold, threshold_policy_version, latency_ms, error_code, reject_reason, requested_at, completed_at) VALUES (#{requestKey}, #{ingestRecordId}, #{modelVersionId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{contractVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{contractSha256,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{deploymentMode}, #{status}, #{attackProbability,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{binaryLabel,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{decisionThreshold,jdbcType=DOUBLE}, #{thresholdPolicyVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{latencyMs,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{errorCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{rejectReason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{requestedAt}, #{completedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select:
SELECT ir.id, ir.request_key, ir.ingest_record_id, r.source_record_key, r.batch_id, b.data_source_id, r.asset_id, ir.model_version_id, mv.model_key, mv.version model_version, ir.contract_version, ir.contract_sha256, ir.deployment_mode, ir.status, ir.attack_probability, ir.binary_label, ir.decision_threshold, ir.threshold_policy_version, ir.latency_ms, ir.error_code, ir.reject_reason, ir.requested_at, ir.completed_at
ORDER BY ir.requested_at DESC, ir.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
